:::{#def-negative-agreement}
#### Negative agreement

The **negative agreement**
(also called the *average negative agreement*)
of an agreement table (@def-agreement-table)
with $2d + b + c > 0$
is the number of negative calls the agent and the reference share,
counted once for each classifier,
as a proportion of all their negative calls:

$$p_{\text{neg}} \eqdef \frac{2d}{2d + b + c}$$

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@cicchetti1990high.
